Please do not post real customer files, private schema names, credentials, personal data, or sensitive paths. Public issues are processed with AI assistance. Do not paste commands for an agent to execute; describe the expected and observed result.

- VS Code version, OS, CopyPreflight version:
- Which recurring task are you doing? (General description only.)
- Minimal synthetic CSV and profile:
- Expected and observed check result:
- Did you complete a useful check? yes / no / not tried
- Have you used it on a second occasion? yes / no / not yet
- Current alternative (CSVLinter / Frictionless / COPY / custom script / other):
- Would you choose a future supported product at USD9/month before tax? yes / no / unsure
- What additional value would justify that price? (No purchase obligation.)

If you accidentally posted private data, edit your own post promptly and report the exposure without repeating its contents. This public channel cannot accept private files.
